english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Tryk på kameraet for at scanne dit første dokument.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
B&W [??: Danish abbreviation S&H (sort-hvid), fine in Danish]

english: Documents inside will not be deleted.
target: Dokumenter indeni vil ikke blive slettet.
backtrans: Documents inside will not be deleted.

english: No documents in this folder yet.
target: Ingen dokumenter i denne mappe endnu.
backtrans: No documents in this folder yet.

english: This folder is no longer available.
target: Denne mappe er ikke længere tilgængelig.
backtrans: This folder is no longer available.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: Dette er ikke automatisk synkronisering. Eksport opretter en enkelt krypteret sikkerhedskopi som du selv flytter til din nye enhed og derefter importerer der.
backtrans: This is not automatic synchronization. Export creates a single encrypted backup which you yourself move to your new device and then import there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.
target: Kunne ikke importere denne sikkerhedskopi. Tjek adgangskoden og prøv igen.
backtrans: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.

target: Denne sikkerhedskopifil ser ud til at være beskadiget.
backtrans: This backup file appears to be damaged.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}
target: {count, plural, =1{1 dokument importeret} other{{count} dokumenter importeret}}
backtrans: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}

english: Pricing is still loading — try again in a moment.
target: Priser indlæses stadig — prøv igen om et øjeblik.
backtrans: Prices are still loading — try again in a moment.

english: This scan is no longer available.
target: Denne scanning er ikke længere tilgængelig.
backtrans: This scan is no longer available.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes, and eraser strokes on this page.
target: Dette vil fortryde alle filtre, rotationer, beskæringer, størrelsesændringer og viskestreger på denne side.
backtrans: This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, size changes and eraser strokes on this page. [??: 'viskestreger' = wipe/eraser strokes, slightly odd]

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Forsiden er scannet. Scan nu bagsiden.
backtrans: The front side has been scanned. Now scan the back side.

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: Brug gemt underskrift eller tegn en ny?
backtrans: Use saved signature or draw a new one?
Cross [??: 'Kryds' means cross/X mark, not checkmark; possibly ambiguous for a tick]

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: Ingen dokumenter at batcheksportere. Scan nogle først.
backtrans: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Ingen mapper endnu. Opret en fra startskærmen.
backtrans: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Kopier tekst til udklipsholder efter scanning
backtrans: Copy text to clipboard after scanning

target: Afspil lyd når scanning er fuldført
backtrans: Play sound when scan is completed

target: Haptisk feedback når scanning er fuldført
backtrans: Haptic feedback when scan is completed
On request [??: 'Efter forespørgsel' = upon request/inquiry; likely means 'on demand' but reads like 'after query']

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: DOCX-kilder gengives dårligt som sider — gemning i appen er begrænset til JPG/PNG fra billede, PDF, TXT eller CSV-kilder. Brug Eksporter og del for denne fil.
backtrans: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — saving in the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export and share for this file. [??: 'gemning' (saving) is slightly unusual/awkward spelling]

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: For at gemme i appen, vælg JPG eller PNG. Andre mål eksporteres som filer.
backtrans: To save in the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Tryk på et sted for at tage farveprøve
backtrans: Tap a spot to take a color sample
Selection erase [??: 'Markeringsviskning' = marking/selection wiping; 'marquee' rendered somewhat awkwardly]

target: Fejl ved generering af ID PDF
OCR ikke tilgængelig på denne enhed.
backtrans: OCR not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Din enhed understøtter ikke den avancerede dokumentscanner. Tag et foto med Kamera-appen og tryk derefter på Importer nedenfor for at beskære og gemme det.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the Camera app and then tap Import below to crop and save it.

target: Fakturering ikke tilgængelig — prøv igen senere.
backtrans: Billing not available — try again later.

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Ingen internet. Opret forbindelse en gang for at downloade sprogpakken.
backtrans: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: Sprogpakke downloades eller er ikke klar. Prøv igen om et øjeblik.
backtrans: Language pack is downloading or is not ready. Try again in a moment.
Save as fragment [??: 'fragment' for snippet, slightly literal]

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: DINE DOKUMENTER BLIVER PÅ DIN ENHED
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Hele dit dokumentkontor — scan, rediger, underskriv og eksporter — i en privat app.
backtrans: Your whole document office — scan, edit, sign and export — in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Annoter, underskriv, vandmærk, udfyld formularer, stempl med segl og mere — hvert værktøj gratis og ubegrænset.
backtrans: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill in forms, stamp with seals and more — every tool free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Brug KatharScan på {count} sprog. OCR kører på din telefon — intet forlader din enhed.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves your device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: E-underskriv kontrakter, udfyld formularer og stempl virksomhedssegl på sekunder.
backtrans: E-sign contracts, fill in forms and stamp company seals in seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Hver redigering forbliver reversibel — fortryd, gentag og gendan til original når som helst.
backtrans: Every edit remains reversible — undo, repeat and restore to original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Ingen konto, ingen sky, ingen vandmærker. Dine dokumenter forlader aldrig din enhed.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Støt KatharScan med et engangskøb. Alle funktioner forbliver gratis.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Dette er et ikke-forbrugskøb. Gendan det når som helst på hvilken som helst enhed med samme butikskonto.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it at any time on any device with the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan stødte på et problem med at vise denne skærm. Dine scanninger er sikre — de gemmes på denne enhed og dette påvirker dem ikke.
backtrans: KatharScan encountered a problem with displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they are saved on this device and this does not affect them.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Ingen mapper endnu. Tryk på mappeikonet for at oprette en.
backtrans: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Ingen favoritter endnu. Tryk på stjerneikonet på et dokument for at tilføje det.
backtrans: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
Light [??: 'Lys' = light/bright; for 'Value' in HSV, ambiguous]

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Del det med venner der har brug for en kraftfuld dokumentscanner.
backtrans: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Din feedback hjælper os med at vokse og holder appen gratis.
backtrans: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
Cross [??: 'Kryds' = cross/X, may be meant as checkmark]
Crimson [??: 'Karmoisin' is an unusual/archaic word for crimson]

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: Velkommen til KatharScan! Dette er den første offentlige version med ubegrænset scanning, 29 sprog og eksport til PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG og CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public version with unlimited scanning, 29 languages and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
backtrans: Allow background reminders for non-exported documents

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
target: Tillad at appen af og til beder om en bedømmelse
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
target: Tillad at appen af og til foreslår deling
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: Siderne kunne ikke vedhæftes e-mailen. Brug Del for at sende siderne.
backtrans: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Dette dokument har endnu ingen tekst. Kør OCR på det først.
backtrans: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: Dine seneste ændringer kunne ikke gemmes.
backtrans: Your latest changes could not be saved.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Tryk på siden, hvor du vil skrive
backtrans: Tap the page where you want to write

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: Denne PDF har {count} sider. Sider der er billeder læses med OCR (ca. 10 sekunder hver); sider med rigtig tekst er øjeblikkelige.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are images are read with OCR (approx. 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or type a new one

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
backtrans: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)

english: Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: Kunne ikke finde sidens kanter. Træk i hjørnerne.
backtrans: Could not find the edges of the page. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Forstørrelse tilføjer ingen detaljer – siden kan se sløret ud.
backtrans: Enlargement adds no detail – the page may look blurry.

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
target: Slet {count} sider? De fjernes, når du gemmer.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: Kunne ikke komme under {mb} MB; den mindste version blev sendt.
backtrans: Could not get below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
